animations.name: Low Forward Kick
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied standing guard pose. In one crisp, controlled motion, the fighter shifts weight onto the rear supporting leg, leans the torso backward about 25 degrees for counterbalance, and snaps the front leg straight out forward and diagonally downward at about a 40-degree angle into a sharp low-to-mid forward kick with the foot pointed forward. Simultaneously, the near arm bends sharply with the forearm raised diagonally across the face in a tight guard while the far arm extends diagonally forward and downward above the kicking thigh for balance, head looking down-right toward the target. Keep the rear foot planted firmly on the ground baseline. Preserve Oscar's exact face, black sweater, black jeans, black sneakers, proportions, scale, right-facing view and pixel art style. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
